q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of vermicelli per kg?
title: Vermicelli carbon footprint per kg
short: Add the wheat semolina or flour per kg with the mill's figure, then mixing, extrusion, drying and roasting energy. Divide the unit's fuel and electricity by kg packed and add packing.

ul: Semolina or refined flour by weight.
Drying chambers, often heated by steam or gas.

p: Report per kg of vermicelli. Drying is often the largest energy use in the plant.

example.title: Worked example: vermicelli unit per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 28,000 / 250,000 = 0.112 kg CO2 per kg
Add semolina and packing for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
